{{Top|leg}}
A '''light sculptor''' was an artist who made [[Light sculpture|sculptures]] out of and using the properties of [[Spectrum/Legends|light]]. One well-known light sculptor was the [[Caamasi/Legends|Caamasi]] artist [[Ves Volette]]. These sculptures were known to be made out of [[compressed energy crystal]]s, which where also used in the construction of [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]]. <ref name="Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows">''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]''</ref>
